title: Calibrate a 4–20 mA input
summary: Apply zero and span references to a Northstar analog input while preserving version 3.2 channel diagnostics.

sections.title: Two-point calibration
paragraphs: Version 3.2 records the reference instrument identifier with each calibration event.

warning.condition: Calibration is started while the channel controls an active process.
warning.consequence: Injected references can be interpreted as real process values.
warning.avoidance: Place the loop in a reviewed manual or maintenance state before injecting current.

steps: Record the reference instrument identifier and calibration date.
Apply 4.000 mA and accept the zero reference after stabilization.
Apply 20.000 mA and accept the span reference after stabilization.
Return the source to 12.000 mA and verify the midpoint tolerance.
Restore the loop and confirm value, unit, quality, and timestamp.
